items.claim: The project separates executable local evidence from unresolved confirmation gates.
items.evidence: Asset inventory, unified manifests, TIGPR local NO-GO, Res-SAM local manifest, 4TU metadata/groupholdout feasibility, external validation readiness gate.
items.boundary: This figure is a protocol/asset map, not a performance result.
items.next_action: Draw workflow schematic after finalizing visual style.

items.claim: Res-SAM environment transfer is the strongest current cross-model signal.
items.evidence: res_sam within_minus_transfer_real_world_to_synthetic: directional=5/5, material=5/5, mean_delta=0.4239, status=supported; res_sam within_minus_transfer_synthetic_to_real_world: directional=4/5, material=4/5, mean_delta=0.3743, status=supported; mojahid random_minus_grouped_balanced_accuracy: directional=5/5, material=1/5, mean_delta=0.0406, status=directional_only.
items.boundary: Scope is Mojahid and Res-SAM only; 4TU and blind external assets are not included in this matrix.
items.next_action: Plot model-family deltas and claim-level support counts.

items.claim: Mojahid random-minus-grouped performance inflation is directionally consistent but modest/model-dependent.
items.evidence: mojahid random_minus_grouped_balanced_accuracy: directional=5/5, material=1/5, mean_delta=0.0406, status=directional_only
items.boundary: Do not frame as a universal leakage effect; only 1/5 model families reaches material support.
items.next_action: Use as secondary panel or combine with Figure 2 rather than lead result.

items.claim: 4TU multi-layer counterfactual stress-test evidence remains a feasibility-boundary layer rather than main confirmation.
items.evidence: HOG fixed-split Land type ExtraTrees log_clip BA_mean=0.0905, delta_mean=-0.3429, flip_mean=0.8583; group-aware selected ExtraTrees appears in 2/5 splits with log_clip delta_mean=-0.0422; the five-layer 4TU extension audit keeps all 4TU evidence as stress-test/feasibility-boundary evidence.
items.boundary: This is stress-test and feasibility-boundary evidence, not final causal proof, main confirmation or blind external validation.
items.next_action: Plot fixed-split versus group-aware sensitivity side by side and add a five-layer evidence-boundary inset.

items.claim: Current 4TU labels are insufficient for the main cross-model confirmation layer.
items.evidence: Land type=usable_with_caution; Land use=not_viable_for_group_holdout; Land cover=weak_due_to_single_project_labels; Utility crossing=usable_with_caution; Construction workers=not_viable_for_group_holdout; Relative groundwater level=weak_due_to_single_project_labels
items.boundary: This is a gate/failure-mode result; it supports study design decisions, not model superiority.
items.next_action: Consider moving to Extended Data if main text is too crowded.

items.claim: Blind external validation remains unavailable under the frozen protocol.
items.evidence: External readiness gate=NO-GO; tracks: A=not_ready; B=not_started; C=not_ready; D=already_used_in_model_matrix; locked evaluation mode=template_dry_run with status=PASS.
items.boundary: The locked evaluation is template dry-run only; no manuscript claim can call it real blind external validation.
items.next_action: Replace with real external result only after strict-sha manifest, frozen prediction and label unlock.

items.claim: Only Mojahid, 4TU and Res-SAM are executable local assets at this checkpoint; TIGPR is supporting-only.
items.evidence: Mojahid=2524 rows; 4TU=99 rows; Res-SAM=1050 rows; TIGPR=0 local executable rows.
items.boundary: Counts are local executable rows, not global dataset sizes.

items.claim: Cross-model material support is strong for Res-SAM transfer and weak for Mojahid split inflation.
items.evidence: mojahid random_minus_grouped_balanced_accuracy: directional=5/5, material=1/5, mean_delta=0.0406, status=directional_only; res_sam within_minus_transfer_real_world_to_synthetic: directional=5/5, material=5/5, mean_delta=0.4239, status=supported; res_sam within_minus_transfer_synthetic_to_real_world: directional=4/5, material=4/5, mean_delta=0.3743, status=supported
items.boundary: Summary excludes 4TU and true blind external validation.
items.next_action: Use as main or extended table depending on Figure 2 density.
